checks.name: positive-prompts
checks.detail: Six deterministic package, protocol, admission, workflow, MCP, and native tests pass. The real KiCad 10.0.5 canary launches an isolated PCB Editor, connects through the official version-bound IPC API, creates and moves owned board text, changes the title, saves, reconnects with an independent client for native-memory and saved-file readback, renders through separately bound kicad-cli 10.0.5, and restores the exact original bytes, memory digest, and revision.

checks.name: negative-prompts
checks.detail: The six closed schemas and runtime reject raw RPC or protocol payloads, arbitrary code, scripts, commands, shell fields, extra fields, traversal, non-enrolled or non-board paths, unsupported actions or formats, invalid coordinates and ownership markers, stale revisions, dirty synchronized state, foreign checkpoints, and foreign receipts.

checks.name: missing-context
checks.detail: Mutation requires the exact KiCad 10.0.5 PCB Editor, IPC schema, kicad-python runtime, and CLI identities; a prepared isolated profile; an enrolled saved board; the bridge-owned process and socket; a synchronized clean native-memory and saved-file pair; the exact current revision; and 1..32 admitted semantic actions.

checks.name: failure-prompts
checks.detail: The workflow and native canary exercise immutable checkpoint and receipt restoration. Rollback refuses post-state drift before writing, verifies receipt and checkpoint identity, restores original board bytes, commands a native revert, independently rereads memory and file state, and requires exact original memory digest, file digest, revision, and clean synchronization.
